title: Microsoft warns of phishing campaign after Outlook disruption
content_md:
"Some emails could not be delivered. To get them, click the button," reads the shortened message in a fraudulent notification. Consumer protection agency warning: Microsoft warns of a phishing campaign after the Outlook disruption.

via Mastodon https://www.verbraucherzentrale.nrw/warnungen/microsoft-warnt-nach-outlookstoerung-vor-phishingkampagne-127229
exclude_reason: Consumer warning about an Outlook outage phishing wave already covered by the existing M365 outage phishing story.
